product_metadata.title: Fishers Finery 30mm 100% Pure Mulberry Silk Pillowcase, Good Housekeeping Quality Tested (Taupe, King)
features: GOOD HOUSEKEEPING APPROVAL: The experts at Good Housekeeping Magazine awarded our silk pillowcase with their prestigious seal of approval. Thorough product testing is required in order to receive this honor.

LUXURIOUS BEDDING: Our pillowcase is made of 100% long strand, Grade 6A Pure Mulberry Silk. There is silk on BOTH sides of the pillowcase! The density of silk is measured by momme. The higher the momme, the more silk. We have added a unique side entry that is slightly offset. The pillowcase can be used as both a sham or pillowcase. An oversized, envelope flap ensures the pillow will remain securely inside your pillowcase.
HEALTH BENEFITS: 100% Pure Mulberry Silk has been tested and proven to Prevent Wrinkles, Regulate Sleep Temperature, Protect Hair Damage & retain mositure.

SIZING: Standard, Queen and King. Our Standard pillowcase measures 20" x 28", Queen pillowcase measures 20" x 30"and the King pillowcase measures 20" x 36". This pillowcase comes beautifully wrapped in our custom Black Label Box, making it a perfect gift for a holiday or special occasion!
CARE INSTRUCTIONS: Dry clean or hand wash are the best methods. You can also machine wash on the gentle cycle. We suggest to use a mesh wash bag when do so. Lay flat to dry.

details.Care instructions: Dry Clean Only, Hand Wash Only
